headline: Gold Prices Reach Two-Week High Amid Wall Street Caution
summary: Gold prices rose to a two-week high on Thursday as the US dollar and Treasury yields weakened. Investors showed increased caution in Wall Street markets following the US midterm elections.
why: Gold is often viewed as a safe-haven asset during periods of market uncertainty or when the US dollar and interest rates decline.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Safe-haven demand increases as market uncertainty rises.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Weakening Treasury yields and a softer dollar reduce the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding assets like gold.
